title: The completed-module finite coefficients and their quotient maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $X$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. On its small pro-etale site put $C_m=(\mathcal O_E/\pi^{m+1})_X$ and $B=\lim_m C_m$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Define the finite coefficient module to be the unit module over $C_m$ restricted along the actual projection $B\to C_m$ [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define its quotient map from index $n+1$ to $n$ by the section functions of the prescribed constant quotient ring map $C_{n+1}\to C_n$. The inverse-limit coordinate equation supplies its B-linearity. These are explicit constructions, with no exactness or existence assertion.
